comment: Object summaries from the same catalog (the Description cell / lead sentence), as a user pasting a description. expect = the object's pages plus every page whose text contains the summary. Built 2026-10-02 against the serenedb main docs.

Swaps the X and Y of every vertex. Useful for data stored in latitude/longitude order.

Disables invalidating the database instance when encountering a fatal error. Should be used with great care, as SereneDB cannot guarantee correct behavior after a fatal error.

Match indexed tokens against a SQL LIKE pattern.

Configures the use of the deprecated union syntax for USING KEY CTEs.

Signature. BM25(tableoid) -> FLOAT, BM25(tableoid, k1, b) -> FLOAT. Captures. Term-frequency saturation plus document-length normalization — the best all-round relevance signal.
Signature. TFIDF(tableoid) -> FLOAT, TFIDF(tableoid, with_norms) -> FLOAT. Captures. Term frequency weighted by inverse document frequency — a simple, classic baseline.

Returns the length of a line in metres on the WGS84 spheroid. The example spans one degree of latitude, which is why the result is close to 110.6 km rather than the 111.3 km of a degree of longitude at the equator.
Returns the MD5 hash of the string as a VARCHAR.
A list of metric glob patterns to enable for collection (e.g. ['query.', 'optimizer.']).
Parsed full-text query, see Full-Text Search Functions
Alias of log. Computes the base-10 logarithm of x.

Signature. raw_dl(tableoid) -> FLOAT. No parameters. Captures. The length of the matched column for each row — the normalization input that BM25(b>0) and the lm_*/dfi scorers use internally.
Computes e ** x.

In the common case — highlighting the same column you searched — pass the indexed column directly and SereneDB synthesizes the offsets for you from the query predicate. This is exactly equivalent to ts_highlight(column, ts_offsets(column) [, options]) but spares you spelling out the offset call:
Returns true if string contains the regexp pattern, false otherwise. A set of optional options can be set.

Computes the inverse hyperbolic cosine of x.

Computes the log of the gamma function.

Truncate timestamptz to a grid of width bucket_width. The grid is anchored at the origin timestamp, which defaults to 2000-01-01 00:00:00 in the provided timezone when bucket_width is a number of months or coarser units, else 2000-01-03 00:00:00 in the provided timezone. The default timezone is 'UTC'. Note that 2000-01-03 is a Monday.
Returns the area of the geometry. Points and lines have zero area.
Decodes a URL from a representation using Percent-Encoding.
Use the date parts of the timestamp in GMT to construct a timestamp in the given time zone. Effectively, the argument is a “local” time.

The exact pos-quantile of x for 0 <= pos <= 1, an alias of quantile_disc. If pos is a LIST of FLOATs the result is a LIST of the corresponding quantiles. For an approximate answer over large inputs see approx_quantile.
Extract the right-most count characters.
Computes the cross product of two arrays of size 3. The array elements cannot be NULL.
Forces upfront download of file
The CREATE TABLE statement creates a table in the catalog.
Synonym for the current_localtimestamp() function call.
Finds non-overlapping occurrences of the regex in the string and returns the corresponding values of the capturing group. A set of optional regex options can be set.
The number of rows to accumulate before sorting, used for tuning
Number of bytes in string.
Rotates the geometry around the Y axis. See the ST_RotateX example.
The TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE for the given parts in the current time zone.
The amount of pages per task.

Returns an empty map.

Maximum number of IVF centroid-tree children expanded per node while descending to the probed clusters. Decouples the descent width from sdb_ivf_search_nprobe: lower values cut centroid work on deep (multi-level) trees at some recall cost. The width applies per node and so compounds over the tree's levels; it is raised when smaller than the width whose compounded value reaches sdb_ivf_search_nprobe, so the descent can always supply the requested number of clusters. Default 16.
Sets the current role.
Minimum size of a rowgroup to enable VARIANT shredding, or set to -1 to disable entirely. Defaults to 1/4th of a rowgroup
Turn the display of completion suggestions on or off.
Returns a map created from merging the input maps. On key collision the value is taken from the last map with that key.

Returns expr evaluated at the row that is offset rows after the current row (among rows with a non-null value of expr if IGNORE NULLS is set) within the window frame; if there is no such row, instead return default (which must be of the same type as expr). Both offset and default are evaluated with respect to the current row. If omitted, offset defaults to 1 and default to NULL. If an ORDER BY clause is specified, the leading row number is computed within the frame using the provided ordering instead of the frame ordering.
Render in single-line mode.
Show the output of the next command in a spreadsheet.
Sets the output format for bytea.
Returns the current transaction's identifier, a BIGINT value. It will assign a new one if the current transaction does not have one already.

Zips n LISTs to a new LIST whose length will be that of the longest list. Its elements are structs of n elements from each list list_1, …, list_n, missing elements are replaced with NULL. If truncate is set, all lists are truncated to the smallest list length. Alias: array_zip.

Formats a string using printf syntax.

An integer ranging from 1 to num_buckets, dividing the partition as equally as possible. If an ORDER BY clause is specified, the ntile is computed within the frame using the provided ordering instead of the frame ordering.
Construct an hour interval.
Euclidean (L2) distance between two equal-length FLOAT vectors — the straight-line distance in space.

Removes vertices that fall within tolerance, using the Douglas-Peucker algorithm. The result may be invalid or may break topology shared with neighbouring geometries; there is no ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology.

Reduce a list of tokens to a MinHash signature and return it as a LIST(BLOB). Two documents that share most of their tokens share most of their signature, so the number of matching components estimates the Jaccard similarity of their token sets.
ISO Year number (Starts on Monday of week containing Jan 4th).
Set the directory to which persistent secrets are stored
Moves every vertex by dx along X, dy along Y and, when given, dz along Z. Without dz the Z coordinates are left as they are.

Returns the M value of a line at the position closest to point. It is the inverse of ST_LocateAlong.

The SHOW statement inspects the database — it lists tables, databases and schemas, shows the schema of a relation and displays the values of session variables.

Finds the row with the minimum val and calculates the arg expression at that row. Rows where the value of the arg or val expression is NULL are ignored. This function is affected by ordering. Aliases: argmin(arg, val), min_by(arg, val).

The bitstring_agg function takes any integer type as input and returns a bitstring with bits set for each distinct value. The left-most bit represents the smallest value in the column and the right-most bit the maximum value. If possible, the min and max are retrieved from the column statistics. Otherwise, it is also possible to provide the min and max values.
Exit with return code CODE.

The signed number of part boundaries between starttimestamptz and endtimestamptz, inclusive of the larger timestamp and exclusive of the smaller timestamp.
Allow '*' character in URLs users can query
Returns a bitstring with bits set for each distinct position defined in arg. All positions must be within the range [min, max] or an Out of Range Error will be thrown.

Computes the inner product between two arrays of the same size. The array elements cannot be NULL. The arrays can have any size as long as the size is the same for both arguments. Alias: array_dot_product.
Return a random UUID (UUIDv4) similar to this: eeccb8c5-9943-b2bb-bb5e-222f4e14b687.

Number of bytes in blob.

Whether or not the global http metadata is used to cache HTTP metadata
Repeats the list count number of times.
Applies aggregate function median to the list.
A dictionary of multiple named values, each key having the same type and each value having the same type. Keys and values can be any type and can be different types from one another.

Username for HTTP proxy
Change the column and row separators.
Access mode of the database (AUTOMATIC, READ_ONLY or READ_WRITE)
The CREATE MACRO statement can create a scalar or table macro (function) in the catalog.
Multiplies the coordinates of every vertex by xs, ys and, when given, zs.
Returns true if the floating point value is finite, false otherwise.
Returns true if the geometries have the same dimension and share some, but not all, of their interiors.

Round to next even number by rounding away from zero.

The sample covariance, which includes Bessel's bias correction.
OR over a list of sub-queries, with an optional "match at least N" threshold.

Full-text search over titles, breadcrumbs and body text, ranked with BM25. Returns path, title, breadcrumb, a snippet of up to 400 characters of the body text, ending in … when it is cut, and the score, best match first. Without max_hits, or with max_hits set to NULL, every match is returned.

Return filenames found at the location indicated by the _search_path_ in a single column named file. The _search_path_ may contain glob pattern matching syntax.
Extracts the century of a timestamp.
Partially process tasks before rescheduling - allows for more scheduler fairness between separate queries
Whether export to Arrow format should use ListView as the physical layout for LIST columns
Combination of time and date
LIST(INTEGER): live documents per term, aligned with ts_dict_agg.
Concatenates the column string values with a comma separator (,). This function is affected by ordering. Aliases: group_concat(arg), listagg(arg).

Resizes the list to contain size elements. Initializes new elements with value or NULL if value is not set. Alias: array_resize.
Show help for the commands matching PATTERN.
Splits the string along the separator. Aliases: split, str_split, string_to_array.
Set the maximum number of rows shown in duckbox mode, 40 by default.

True for rows whose indexed geometry shares any space with shape — touching an edge or a single point counts. This is the workhorse predicate: a bounding box, a neighbourhood polygon or a single point all flow through the same call.
Like arg_min_null, but rows whose val expression is NULL are also kept, and are ordered after every row with a value. Takes an optional third argument n for the bottom n rows.
The sample standard deviation.
